info.name: Otodata Nee-Vo API v29
info.description:
Web service for accessing Otodata Remote Tank Level Monitor (RTLM) readings. Modified: April 24, 2026.

**Authentication:** Set the `API_KEY` collection variable to your API key. All requests use Bearer token auth via the Authorization header.

**Base URL:** Set the `baseUrl` collection variable. Defaults to primary server.

**Primary Servers:**
- https://telematics.otodatanetwork.com:4431
- https://neevo.otodata.ca

**Secondary Servers:**
- https://telematics02.otodatanetwork.com:4431
- https://neevo2.otodata.ca

variable.description: Primary server base URL. Alternatives: https://neevo.otodata.ca, https://telematics02.otodatanetwork.com:4431 (secondary), https://neevo2.otodata.ca (secondary)
Your Otodata Nee-Vo API Key. Generate at: https://neevo.otodata.ca/#/integrations/apikey
Default device serial number for requests

query.description: ISO8601 UTC date filter. Example: 2018-11-22T13:00:00Z. Only return devices updated after this date.

request.description:
Returns a list of all modules linked to the authenticated company. Optionally filter by `lastDateUtc` to return only devices updated after that timestamp.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: Array of Device objects
- 400 Bad Request: `lastDateUtc` does not follow ISO8601 format
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid

query.description: Sensor index (0-based). Default: 0

request.description:
Returns a single module by its serial number.

**URL Parameters:**
- `deviceId`: Integer device serial number (required)
- `sensor`: Sensor index, 0-based (optional, default: 0)

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: Device object
- 400 Bad Request: `id` is not an integer
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid
- 404 Not Found: `id` is missing or invalid

Returns a dummy module for testing. No authentication required.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: Device object (sample data)

Returns the warranty history for a module, ordered newest to oldest.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: List of DeviceWarranty objects
- 400 Bad Request: `id` is not an integer
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid
- 404 Not Found: `id` is missing or invalid

**WarrantyStatus values:** 0=Unknown(Obsolete), 1=NoWarranty(Obsolete), 2=NotStarted, 3=Expired, 4=Active, 5=BatteryWarrantyOnly(Obsolete), 6=Voided, 7=Archived

**WarrantyType values:** 0=Standard, 1=Extended, 2=BatteryPackOnly

request.description:
Modifies a module's properties.

**Notes:**
- Each tank format may be associated to a specific product. To assign a tank format, both must be associated to the same product.
- Associating a `TankFormatName` automatically sets: Capacity, TankFormType, MeasureDepth, MeasureHeight, MeasureWidth, Offset, TareWeight, MaxUllage.
- Capacity can only be set directly if device has no tank format.
- Updating Product to a different value unassigns the tank format.
- For hydrostatic sensors, product density must be 0.3–2.0 g/cm³.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: DeviceUpdateResult object
- 400 Bad Request: `id` is not an integer
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid
- 404 Not Found: `id` is missing or invalid

Clears all customer data from the Nee-Vo database for a device. The `Exclude` array lists Device model property names to preserve (not reset).

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: Empty body
- 400 Bad Request: `id` is not an integer

item.name: Tank Levels
item.description: Endpoints for retrieving historical tank level readings.

query.description: ISO8601 UTC start date (required). Example: 2018-04-25T08:30:00Z
ISO8601 UTC end date (required). Example: 2019-01-10T20:30:00Z
Page index (0-based). Max 10,000 readings per page. Default: 0

request.description:
Gets historical level readings for all modules linked to the company. Results are paginated at 10,000 readings per page.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: TankLevels object
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid
- 404 Not Found: `startDateUtc` or `endDateUtc` missing or invalid

**ValueType values:**
- 0 = Percentage (value ÷ 100 = %)
- 1 = Distance in mm (value ÷ 1000 = meters)
- 2 = Quantity (counter)
- 3 = Temperature in deciKelvin (value ÷ 10 − 273.15 = °C)

query.description: ISO8601 UTC start date (required). Example: 2018-04-25T08:30:00Z
ISO8601 UTC end date (required). Example: 2019-01-10T20:30:00Z
Sensor index (0-based). Default: 0

request.description:
Gets historical level readings for a single module.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: TankLevels object
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid
- 404 Not Found: `id`, `startDateUtc`, or `endDateUtc` missing or invalid

query.description: Output format. Values: Excel (default), CSV, SuburbanSoftware
Exclude non-installed devices from the report
Include sub-company devices in the report

request.description:
Downloads a summary report as a file.

**Supported formats:**
- `Excel` (default)
- `CSV`
- `SuburbanSoftware`

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: Byte stream (file)
- 204 No Content
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid

item.name: Return Requests
item.description: Endpoints for managing device return requests.

query.description: Required. true = open/not completed; false = completed
Page index (0-based). Max 100 per page. Default: 0

request.description:
Gets return requests and associated items linked to the company. Paginated at 100 per page.

**ReturnRequestStatus values:**
- 0 = Pending
- 1 = Analyzing
- 2 = Completed
- 3 = RmaReady

**ReturnRequestItemStatus values:**
- 0 = Pending
- 1 = Accepted
- 2 = Refused

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: List of ReturnRequest objects
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid

Gets a single return request by ID.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: ReturnRequest object
- 400 Bad Request: `id` is not valid
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid

Modifies the comment of a return request.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: UpdateReturnRequestResult object
- 400 Bad Request: `id` format invalid or nothing to update
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid, or client not found

item.name: RMAs
item.description: Endpoints for managing Return Merchandise Authorizations.

query.description: Required. true = open/not completed; false = completed
Page index (0-based). Max 100 per page. Default: 0

request.description:
Gets a list of RMAs and associated items linked to the company. Paginated at 100 per page.

**RmaItemStatus values:**
- 0 = Pending Analysis
- 1 = Being Analyzed
- 2 = Complete
- 3 = Pending Receipt
- 4 = Not Received
- 5 = Ignored

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: List of Rma objects
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid

Gets a single RMA and its associated items.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: Rma object
- 403 Forbidden: API key or `id` missing or invalid

Modifies a RMA item's reconciliation status and/or customer comment.

**URL Parameters:**
- `rmaId`: RMA ID string (e.g., RMA001)
- `deviceId`: Device serial number integer

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: RmaItemUpdateResult object
- 400 Bad Request: `id` format invalid, nothing to update, or RMA ID missing
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid

item.name: Gas Meters
item.description: Endpoints for retrieving gas meter readings.

query.description: ISO8601 UTC start date (required). Example: 2025-01-15T00:00:00Z
ISO8601 UTC end date (required). Example: 2025-02-15T00:00:00Z
Page index (0-based). Max 10,000 meters per page. Default: 0

request.description:
Gets historical readings for all modules with a gas meter sensor. Results are paginated at 10,000 meters per page.

**Responses:**
- 200 OK: GasMeters object
- 403 Forbidden: API key missing or invalid
- 404 Not Found: `startDateUtc` or `endDateUtc` missing or invalid
